items.title: Macaulay Culkin's thousand-yard stare costume, mistaken for blackface
items.summary: Macaulay Culkin posted a dim Halloween selfie in a tilted helmet and olive-green face paint, recreating the thousand-yard stare soldier meme, captioned "War. War never changes." DiscussingFilm's repost late on Oct 31 drew 351K likes and 16.5M views, and through Nov 1 the argument was whether the warm lighting made it look like blackface: "Great costume but one small issue" (48K) became the line everyone quoted, and X added a note saying the paint was green. Paparazzi photos then showed he was a green army man from Toy Story, trick-or-treating with Brenda Song as Jessie and their son as Buzz Lightyear.
items.author: @DiscussingFilm
